aggregation: sum twenty steps; median repeats within geometry; then median/range and paired ratios across geometries; all failures retained

split_audit.note: Checks saved split metadata and available prior hashes; no coefficient fields are regenerated.

probe.timing_scope: setup_seconds is current-space processing only; it excludes historical collection, current-retrospective extraction, projection and preconditioner construction. It is not a complete comparable online cost.

frozen_selection.rule: Fastest accurate zero-failure zero-space-rejection budget-valid method among four causal event strategies on development only; selection does not imply gain.

integration_smoke.role: Functional check only; excluded seed; schedules and <=8A/8M budgets checked; no timings used for selection.

record.note: All unit tests after narrow LinAlgError fallback added; 140-row integration before that exception-only addition. No formal data used to modify algorithms.
